import os

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5)]
    (r1, c1, a), (r2, c2, b) = markers

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = sorted((r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 5))

    b = max(markers, key=lambda p: p[1])[2]

    r0,rmax=min(rows),max(rows); c0,cmax=min(cols),max(cols)
    rm=(r0+rmax)//2; cm=(c0+cmax)//2
    for r in range(r0+1,rmax):
        for c in range(c0+1,cmax):
            out[r][c] = a if (r <= rm) == (c <= cm) else b
    return out
'''
